clues: This city in Minnesota sits on both banks of the Upper Mississippi River. It sits near the east side of the state.
Winters here are cold and snowy, but summers turn hot and wet. The seasons swap from one hard extreme to the other.
Dakota people lived here first. Settlers then built by a fort and the lone falls on the great river, whose power helped the town grow.
This is the birthplace of Target, General Mills, and the Pillsbury brand. Three names seen on food and store shelves began here.
This place is called the City of Lakes. It has thirteen lakes and a park road that links its parks and green spots.
